frozen_v1_protocol.title: When the Lab Remembers
frozen_v1_protocol.claim: The frozen nominal candidate exceeds a predeclared dimensionless fresh-preparation response threshold of 0.85.
frozen_v1_protocol.scope: Computational benchmark; no experimentally measured materials properties or hardware validation.
frozen_v1_protocol.mass_balance: Fixed final batch mass/volume. actual=(1-r)*nominal+r*residual, with r=rho*eta**wash_count the retained fraction of the final batch; nominal and residual are nonnegative ternary mass fractions summing to one. Washing reduces residual contribution; no solvent blank or unmodeled fourth component is used.
frozen_v1_protocol.fresh_action: An independent preparation and assay of the nominal composition is available to all methods; it leaves the shared line residual unchanged and costs four assumed cost units by default.
frozen_v1_protocol.latent_information: Only the simulator and scorer know true carryover, wash efficacy and clean response. Policies receive commanded compositions, wash counts, fresh flags, assumed costs and noisy observations.
frozen_v1_protocol.inference: Finite-grid Bayesian model averaging over carryover and wash retention; conditional Bayesian linear regression in six quadratic Bernstein mixture features. Noise standard deviation assumed known at 0.03. Primary model assumes last-actual-composition memory.
frozen_v1_protocol.active_action_rule: For the moment-matched joint distribution of clean-candidate latent response theta and the next observation Y, utility is Cov(theta,Y)^2 / Var(Y) / action_cost. This is linear-projection variance reduction, not exact expected Bayesian model-average posterior variance reduction or threshold entropy reduction.

decision.coverage_claim: No finite-sample or arbitrary-misspecification reliability guarantee is claimed.

frozen_v1_protocol.evaluation_seeds: 10000 through 10399 inclusive, disjoint from development seeds 0-19. Same seeded surface across regimes; inference is per regime and no pooled independent-campaign uncertainty is used.
pilot_changes: Original development pilot: seeds 0-9, first six regimes, eight policies, 60 campaigns and 480 policy runs. Completed before report seeds were used. No false confirmations observed in this small pilot; washing and candidate repetition were already competitive.

Increased planned campaigns from 120 to 400 per regime to improve precision for rare false-confirmation rates; did not change response family, peak range, threshold, observation noise or prior based on performance.
Added history_repeat to separate inference from adaptive action selection, and active_no_cost to ablate cost division.
Added expensive wash and cheap/expensive fresh sensitivity, off-grid carryover/wash retention (.32,.35), and severe carryover (.7,.2); all declared before evaluation.
Corrected target-assay classification to nominal composition equality, and added deterministic affordable routine fallback to history_fixed.
Clarified fixed final-volume semantics, known initial residual, approximation used for utility, and hypothetical first-crossing interpretation.
frozen_v1_protocol.primary_evaluation: Fixed budget cap of 16 assumed cost units. Evaluate the final decision after the policy completes its affordable actions. Equal caps do not imply equal realized spend: wash-only and fresh-only policies may retain a remainder smaller than their next scheduled action; history_fixed falls back to affordable routine candidate repetition. No early termination.
outcomes: false fraction among accepted (undefined if no accepts)
false acceptance conditional on invalid candidate
false rejection per campaign and conditional on valid candidate
frozen_v1_protocol.uncertainty: Regime-specific Wilson 95% intervals for rates; 5000 percentile campaign-seed bootstrap replicates for means and paired differences. Same bootstrap seed indices for active/control within each regime. No multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory significance claim.
limitations: The study uses synthetic dimensionless objectives; no material-specific data or laboratory validation.
The primary smooth quadratic response family is contained in the inference model; nonlinear and long-memory regimes deliberately violate assumptions.
Known observation noise and initial residual state simplify inference; unknown calibration/noise and arbitrary hidden apparatus effects are not addressed.
Model probabilities are not universal reliability certificates and no finite-sample frequentist coverage guarantee is claimed.
Carryover magnitudes and costs are controlled assumed scenarios, not measured prevalence or experimental time.
Repeated candidate dispensing can flush carryover; adaptive controls may provide no benefit or may underperform.
Fixed-cost actions can leave different budget remainders; budgets are caps, not equal realized expenditure.
One-step covariance utility ignores look-ahead value and exact Bayesian model-discrimination information.
Same seeded surface is reused across regimes; do not treat regime rows as independent for pooled inference.
frozen_v1_protocol.initial_condition: A known priming mixture h0=[1,0,0] initializes the shared line and every inference particle. Known initialization and known observation sigma=0.03 are favorable assumptions.
frozen_v1_protocol.target_assay_rule: A target assay is any observation whose commanded nominal recipe equals the frozen candidate, including a conditioning vertex if that vertex equals the candidate.
frozen_v1_protocol.illustrations: Development seed 7 in strong_carryover, ineffective_wash and nonlinear_response_stress, declared before evaluation. Full discovery and all-policy trajectories exported. No evaluation example is selected for the main mechanism figure.
frozen_v1_protocol.surface_definition: Abstract dimensionless response: peak - .35*sum_j weight_j*(x_j-center_j)^2; center~Dirichlet(1.5,1.5,1.5), peak~Uniform(.80,1.02), each weight~Uniform(.5,1.1). Nonlinear stress adds .10 sin(8x0+phase0) sin(7x1+phase1)+.12 exp(-||x-bumpcenter||^2/.025)-.03. Phases uniform [0,2pi], bumpcenter~Dirichlet(1.2,1.2,1.2).
frozen_v1_protocol.primary_comparison: active_confirmation versus history_repeat, controlling the inference model and discovery evidence while changing action selection.
frozen_v1_protocol.secondary_stopping_outcome: First non-unresolved threshold crossing and its cost are hypothetical descriptive outputs. Runs continue to the fixed budget cap, so these are not results of an executed early-stopping policy.
frozen_v1_protocol.audit: Independent read-only algebra, latent-boundary, utility and aggregation checks completed before evaluation. Nine deterministic scientific unit tests passed.

frozen_v2_protocol.title: Bound-aware preplanned confirmation on measured-OPV-informed response emulators
frozen_v2_protocol.motivation: The frozen v1 benchmark did not show an advantage for the adaptive covariance policy over history-model repetition. This extension tests stronger repetition controls and a conditional confidence construction, using measured formulation data to define explicitly labeled emulators.
frozen_v2_protocol.v1_preservation: All v1 core code, protocol and report-seed outputs remain unchanged. New source, development and evaluation outputs are stored in this directory.

measured_data.source: Langner et al., Beyond Ternary OPV: High-Throughput Experimentation and Self-Driving Laboratories Optimize Multicomponent Systems, DOI 10.1002/adma.201907801
measured_data.response: degradation_mean from grouped HTE repeated compositions; lower is better. Internally score=1-degradation to preserve a maximize-response convention. Negative measured degradation values are retained; no clipping.
measured_data.scope: Measured degradation supports the response emulator only. No measured carryover, wash efficacy, memory update law, initial residual calibration or Gaussian noise calibration is available.
measured_data.shared_rows: The two systems share constituent measurements on their zero-second-donor face; they are two application cases, not fully independent external replications.
measured_data.eligibility: Nominal candidate recipes satisfy 1/6 <= total donor fraction x0+x1 <= 5/6, matching the source study's donor:acceptor ratio 1:5 to 5:1. On a 0.1 grid this is donor fraction 0.2 to 0.8. Conditioning and residual states may be any simplex mixture.
measured_data.criterion: Fresh nominal degradation <= 0.10, equivalently score >= 0.90; this is an illustrative benchmark criterion, not a claimed universal materials standard.

primary_emulator.family: Prespecified cubic standard multinomial Bernstein polynomial on the four-component simplex, 20 coefficients.
primary_emulator.split: Unique composition groups, common deterministic split seed 880001 across the two systems; force the four pure vertices into training; remaining groups randomly partitioned 70% train, 15% validation, 15% test. Every replicate stays with its composition group.
primary_emulator.selection: Choose ridge strength by validation MAE; ties choose larger ridge. Refit on train+validation, compute the global Lipschitz certificate from that final fit, then evaluate held-out test once. Report test MAE, RMSE, R2, group counts and coefficient/certificate values.
primary_emulator.lipschitz_norm: L1 on the full composition simplex.
primary_emulator.certificate: For degree p and Bernstein coefficients beta, L=(p/2)*max_{|gamma|=p-1,i,j}|beta_(gamma+e_i)-beta_(gamma+e_j)|. Proof from tangent gradient range. Certificate applies to this fitted emulator only, not to the true material.
primary_emulator.policy_boundary: Only scalar L is supplied to a bounded policy. Coefficients and emulator evaluation are private to simulator/scorer. The policy never receives the fitted response function or clean candidate value.

secondary_emulator.family: Predeclared full-data piecewise-affine Delaunay interpolation of grouped measured means, supplied by application/opv_piecewise_affine.py.
secondary_emulator.selection_rule: Use as an emulator sensitivity case regardless of whether its outcomes favor any method; do not choose between emulators based on policy performance.
secondary_emulator.certificate: The independent data module supplies an exactly derived, upward-rounded full-simplex L1 gradient bound; large constants and resulting conservatism are retained.
secondary_emulator.fidelity: Report its separate composition-group holdout coverage and prediction errors; its full-data interpolation is not held-out materials validation.

physical_model.mass_balance: Fixed final mass: actual=(1-r)*nominal+r*residual, r=rho*eta^wash_count. Shared-line residual updates as (1-lambda)*residual+lambda*actual.
physical_model.fresh: Independent nominal preparation and assay, leaves shared-line residual unchanged.
physical_model.noise: Independent Gaussian with known sigma=0.03 in score units, added after evaluating the latent emulator without clipping. This is an explicit simulation assumption, not calibrated from the measured OPV replicate distribution.
physical_model.bounds: The declared rho upper bound, eta upper bound and lambda lower bound are assumed externally supplied instrument-calibration information. The benchmark supplies these hypothetical envelopes; the OPV source does not verify them. All bounded methods receive identical bounds and scalar L.

discovery.candidate_pool: Four-component simplex grid in increments of0.1, restricted by the donor:acceptor eligibility rule.
discovery.optimizer: Stateless Bayesian quadratic Bernstein UCB with weight1.5; no repeated nominal grid points during discovery.
discovery.selection: Highest final stateless posterior-mean tested nominal recipe. Freeze once before all confirmation methods. No apparent-hit filtering.
discovery.common_evidence: Same discovery actions, observed outcomes, frozen candidate and private shared-line starting state for every policy in a seed/system/scenario.

history_model.family: Quadratic four-component Bernstein basis,10 coefficients; Gaussian coefficient prior mean0.6 and covariance0.25I; known sigma0.03; last-actual-mixture memory assumption.
history_model.prior_bounds: Retain only particles consistent with the declared rho/eta upper bounds, so the model controls may use the same available calibration envelope. Model probabilities are not guaranteed under cubic-response or long-memory misspecification.
history_model.active: Original moment-matched covariance-squared/observation-variance/cost utility; conditioning actions are pure-component assays. A no-conditioning ablation uses the same utility over routine/wash1/wash3/fresh candidate actions only.

bounded_inference.recursion: For a candidate shared-line action with k washes, rbar=rho_upper*eta_upper^k, q=1-lambda_lower*(1-rbar), B=L*rbar*D_before, D_after=q*D_before. Fresh B=0 and D unchanged.
bounded_inference.fixed_final_interval: mean(Y_selected) +/- [mean(B_selected)+1.959963984540054*sigma/sqrt(n_selected)]. Every bounded primary schedule and discard rule is fixed before confirmation outcomes; conditional Gaussian coverage >=0.95 for the frozen candidate when the supplied bounds hold.
bounded_inference.decision: Accept if lower endpoint>=0.90; reject if upper endpoint<0.90; otherwise unresolved. At least2 included measurements.
bounded_inference.early_stopping: Primary runs never stop early. If an anytime display is supplied, use separately labeled sigma*sqrt(2*log(2*T/alpha)/n) and averaged predictable bias; do not attach the fixed-final guarantee to optional stopping.
bounded_inference.tail_control: Discard the first4 candidate routine assays, fixed in advance. Subsequent residual/bias bounds still propagate through discarded assays; use only retained observations and their bounds in the interval.

preplanned_method.menu: Routine candidate, one-wash candidate, three-wash candidate, independent fresh candidate.
preplanned_method.optimization: Enumerate every feasible integer count tuple with at least2 total assays and cost<=budget. For each tuple, put stronger washes before weaker washes/routine; place fresh actions last (fresh placement does not affect this objective). Minimize averaged total deterministic bias bound plus the fixed-final Gaussian radius.
preplanned_method.block_formula: n shared actions with retained bound r and q=1-lambda_lower*(1-r) contribute L*r*D*(1-q^n)/(1-q) to summed bias and leave distance D*q^n. Fresh actions contribute zero summed bias and leaveD unchanged.
preplanned_method.ordering_proof: Adjacent r_a<=r_b: summed-bound difference S_ab-S_ba=L*D*lambda_lower*(r_a-r_b)<=0; the final distance product q_a*q_b is invariant. Thus strongest washes first minimize summed bounds for fixed counts.
preplanned_method.optimality_scope: Exact only within this finite menu of fixed candidate-only count schedules that use all their observations equally. No optimality claim over adaptive, tail-discarding, weighted or model-based policies.
preplanned_method.ties: Smallest half-width, then smallest realized cost, then fewest fresh assays, then fewest washes, then more routine assays.

primary_design.development_seeds: 100000 through100019; no development results included in primary estimates.
primary_design.evaluation_seeds: 200000 through200199, disjoint from v1 and development. Same seed reused across systems/scenarios for controlled comparisons; uncertainty is per case and no independent pooled rate is claimed.
primary_design.noise_coupling: Confirmation methods share the same independent standard-normal draw at assay indext (common random numbers), while commanded actions may differ. Routine, tail and bounded-repeat controls therefore share exactly the same raw confirmation observations.
outcomes: conditional sensitivity and invalid-candidate false acceptance
primary_design.uncertainty: Per-case Wilson95% intervals for binary rates;5000 campaign-paired bootstrap replicates for differences and means. Report true-good prevalence. Preserve zero-event and null results.

predeclared_sensitivities.seeds: First100 primary report seeds,200000 through200099, allowing paired comparisons when the underlying emulator and candidate are unchanged.
predeclared_sensitivities.emulator: Repeat these four cases with the independently fixed Delaunay emulator and its own scalarL certificate.
predeclared_sensitivities.broad_bounds: Repeat the same four primary-emulator cases with rho_upper0.8,eta_upper0.9,lambda_lower0.4; all actual parameters remain within these bounds.
predeclared_sensitivities.empirical_contrast_noise: Repeat the same four primary-emulator cases with confirmation noise resampled from symmetric +/- half-differences of the system's measured SDA replicate pairs, preserving outliers. Discovery noise remains Gaussian so the candidate is unchanged. Still using sigma0.03 deliberately violates the main Gaussian/noise-bound assumption; report as an assumption stress, never as covered by the theorem or an empirical noise calibration.
predeclared_sensitivities.budget_diagnostics: Without additional stochastic claims, enumerate planner radius/counts for budgets8,16,32,64 and fresh costs1,2,4,8 for selected primary/broad-bound cases. These show required margins and planning behavior, not empirical success probabilities.
predeclared_sensitivities.equal_fresh_cost: Repeat the same four primary-emulator low/high-carryover cases with fresh_cost=1. At positive sensitivity/carryover bounds, all-fresh maximizes affordable sample count and has zero bias bound, so it should minimize the certified width. This is a physical-cost boundary, not an OPV cost calibration.

pre_evaluation_changes: Before any v2 report seeds, replaced rho0.7 scenario (already tested in v1) with strongly persistent lambda0.05/lower-bound0.04 stress. The moderate-persistence lambda0.45 case is retained. Rationale: test slow natural flushing directly while reducing reliance on extreme carryover fractions. These memory rates are uncalibrated controlled stresses, not measured OPV behavior.

Added equal fresh/routine cost1 sensitivity because OPV fresh-preparation marginal costs are not measured; all-fresh must weakly dominate biased routines in the certified-width objective at equal cost.
Capped deterministic budget diagnostics at64 rather than128 to keep computation proportionate; this does not remove any primary stochastic scenario.
remaining_gates: Lock selected primary emulator before opening held-out fidelity outcomes
Freeze this protocol before any report-seed campaign
frozen_v2_protocol.independent_review: Protocol, fixed-count exchange argument, exhaustive planner, scalar-only information boundary, cubic train/validation/test split, Lipschitz certificates, core confidence/bias logic and result denominators independently cleared before report evaluation.
